correctness.rationale: The graph constructed from isotropic 2-spaces of F_3^4 has 40 projective points, 40 isotropic lines, degree four and diameter four. Independent endpoint-localized full length-five chain enumeration produced C2,C3,C4=(18,81,120) at distance one and (28,87,72) at distance three. Integer Smith invariants of (d3,d4) were (18,63) and (28,50), ALL units, with d3*d4=0. The nine displayed octagon cycles have zero boundary and augment the image of d4 to 59 unimodular Smith factors, giving a free Z^9 quotient. Forty generating symplectic transvections preserved incidence and had ordered point-line orbits of sizes 160 and 1440, exhausting each incidence class. Bipartite odd-length parity excludes same-part endpoints, reversal doubles contributions, yielding 2880*9=25920. These are genuine exhaustive finite calculations for precisely W(3), not extrapolation to arbitrary order.
